source_priority: SCB subject/statistics pages and Statistikdatabasen update dates
inferred annual pattern from adjacent years

quality_levels.observed: Exact publication/update date observed in an authoritative SCB source.
quality_levels.inferred_annual_pattern: Publication period inferred from repeated annual releases; must not be presented as an exact historical date.
quality_levels.conservative_fallback: Safety rule used where exact/inferred timing is insufficient.

annual_population_final.asof_rule: At an April Y forecast origin, final population and migration statistics for Y-1 are available.
annual_population_final.conservative_fallback: Treat final Y-1 population/migration as unavailable before March 1 Y unless an observed earlier SCB publication date is registered.

housing_stock.inferred_rule: When historical exact dates are missing, infer a mid-April release window from adjacent-year SCB releases, mark inferred_annual_pattern, and test a conservative end-of-April cutoff.
housing_stock.conservative_fallback: Unavailable at the April forecast origin unless publication before that origin is documented.

bas_monthly.operational_rule: Use exact observed publication dates when available. Otherwise use inferred annual/monthly pattern and a conservative two-month lag for pseudo-realtime tests.

inference_policy.annual_series: If the current SCB source title/page gives a publication date for reference year Y, the same seasonal publication window may be used as an estimate for Y+1 only when no exact calendar entry exists.
inference_policy.requirement: All inferred dates must carry quality=inferred_annual_pattern and a source/evidence note.
inference_policy.no_leakage: If an inferred release could fall after forecast origin, treat the variable as unavailable.
